guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: adservice is the only service with its own error series (adservice_error 0 -> 0.0222, z=+20) and a socket jump (+38.1%, z=+7.63), while frontend logs 2128 'failed to retrieve ads' lines pointing at it as the failing callee. The paymentservice UnacceptedCreditCard errors are an application-level rejection of visa_electron cards and not an infrastructure fault; adservice_mem (+25%) is secondary, and the socket signal is the strongest resource anomaly.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect adservice connection handling (open sockets/connection leaks, listener backlog, and connection limits), then restart or scale out the adservice pods if sockets are exhausted, and verify that frontend ad retrieval errors stop.
